description: Na₂UO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pccn space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.66 Å. U is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 32°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent U atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂U₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one U atom.
